units: mm; values transcribed from printed metric dimensions, not converted from rounded inch values

body.height_note: Footnote allowing an additional 0.13 mm before mounting applies to optional tin-lead and tin-silver-copper terminations, not E tin-silver. No user maximum-height constraint is inferred.

terminals_for_reference_not_copper.missing_limits: Terminal extent y is typical, and no full independent terminal-location tolerances or coplanarity limit are supplied. Do not claim a complete tolerance-stack proof.

recommended_copper.pad_dimensions_tolerance: Not specified in recommended land drawing
recommended_copper.interpretation: 2.37 mm dimension arrowheads terminate on dashed pad centerlines, not inner pad edges.

orientation.coordinate_convention: Component top / PCB top view, as manufacturer marking is shown; x positive right, y positive down
orientation.pin_numbering: Project convention; manufacturer drawing has no numeric pin labels
orientation.view_handling: Do not mirror the component-top marking view. A reflected underside view would reverse apparent left/right, but the board top pad mapping above stays unchanged. If choosing a rotated library orientation, rotate body mark and pad numbers together.
orientation.electrical_polarity: No functional DC polarity; winding-start orientation is an EMI recommendation.

process_scenario_not_manufacturer_requir.paste: 1:1 copper aperture only as a declared provisional assumption; no vendor stencil specification
process_scenario_not_manufacturer_requir.calculation: The max 4.3 mm body controls both axes; 4.3 + 2*0.25 = 4.8 mm. This is a process scenario, not a manufacturer spacing rule.

undercoil_and_adjacency.claim_boundary: No prohibition found in the reviewed source set does not qualify arbitrary under-body routing or exposed vias. No Murata restriction is inherited. Any project keepout must be explicitly identified as an engineering choice.
undercoil_and_adjacency.manufacturer_general_advice: FAQ gives no universal inductor spacing; interactions depend on current waveform, frequency, orientation and separation. Magnetic shielding reduces field leakage; final circuit measurement is recommended.
undercoil_and_adjacency.doc362_scope: Narrow-spacing warning is explicitly about unshielded inductors; XFL4015 is shielded. It is not a numeric XFL4015 clearance rule.
undercoil_and_adjacency.ground_plane_note: FAQ ground-plane section is framed for RF inductors; it does not establish a specific power-inductor plane/keepout rule for XFL4015.
